Fallout 4, heavily modded.

I pretty much replaced every texture in the game and added tons of stuff, both cosmetic and not. The ENB really does a lot for the game and I have a PC powerful enough to crank the settings to full on Ultra even running huge textures and post processing stuff.

Most of my 'not' cosmetic mods were the type that made things harder, but I do have a few nice weapons tossed in for fun that I really only use for messing around. The BFG mod is super fun for example.

Deathclaws are an absolute terror when I'm actually playing though. The other critters are all beefed up too, but Deathclaws live up to their name. I'm not one of those types who really enjoys the super hardcore survival type mods where you have to eat and sleep regularly, but the game is way too easy for my taste without modding it.

You hear the sound the slide being pulled back and a bullet entering the chamber. The dim moonlight glimmers off the barrel of the gun. He points it to you. You can't help but stare helplessly as you wait for him to end your life. He pulled the trigger and then falls on you. You scream and try to push his limp body off of you. You managed to shove him off to the side and you back yourself against the wall. You wait. You wait for him to move, to get up, to do something, but he doesn't. You cautiously ease along the wall to a light switch and flick it on. The man was on the ground with a pool of blood forming around him, clearly dead. At first you don't understand what happened, but then you notice in his hand was the gun he took from your box. It was a joke gun you bought on a whim.
